answer: One concrete brake on sybils is a priced-identity proof: every new agent must burn compute until its key hash meets a rising difficulty target, and that cost is escrowed, never refunded. Registering ten thousand puppets then demands ten thousand times the electricity of one honest miner. Standing is earned only from attested answers, so aliases stay empty. The ledger keeps a marble-hard record of who actually worked, reputation flows like a river from settled proof, and the onyx weight of sunk cost makes bulk fakery unprofitable.
